sections.title: What Does the Cyber Essentials Assessment Involve?
text: A Cyber Essentials assessment is a structured review of your IT environment to ensure it meets the UK government’s Cyber Essentials security requirements. London IT assesses your systems, policies, and controls to identify risks, close gaps, and prepare your business for successful certification.

sections.title: Cyber Essentials vs Cyber Essentials Plus.
text: Choosing the right Cyber Essentials certification depends on your business size, risk exposure, and client requirements. London IT helps SMEs across London select and achieve the correct level without overcomplicating the process.

THE FOUNDATIONAL LEVEL Cyber Essentials is the entry-level, government-backed cyber security certification designed to protect organisations from the most common cyber threats. It focuses on implementing the five core security controls required to meet the UK’s baseline cyber security standard.
ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS:
BENEFITS Cost-Effective : Ideal for SMEs starting their cyber security journey Baseline Protection: Prevents up to 80% of common cyber attacks
Government Contracts : Meets the minimum requirement for some public sector contracts. Contract Ready : Meets minimum requirements for many public-sector and supply-chain contracts

ADVANCE ASSURANCE Cyber Essentials Plus builds on Cyber Essentials by adding a hands-on technical audit carried out by a certified assessor. It provides a higher level of assurance for businesses handling sensitive data or operating in regulated environments.
ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS:

BENEFITS Enhanced Assurance: Confirms security controls are correctly implemented and effective Increased Trust: Demonstrates strong cyber security to clients, partners, and regulators Reduced Risk: Identifies weaknesses before attackers can exploit them.

London IT provides end-to-end Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus support in London, guiding you from assessment through to certification. Choose the right certification. Reduce risk. Win more contracts.

items.title: Cyber Essentials
items.text: THE FOUNDATIONAL LEVEL Cyber Essentials is the entry-level, government-backed cyber security certification designed to protect organisations from the most common cyber threats. It focuses on implementing the five core security controls required to meet the UK’s baseline cyber security standard. items.title: Cyber Essentials Plus
items.text: ADVANCE ASSURANCE Cyber Essentials Plus builds on Cyber Essentials by adding a hands-on technical audit carried out by a certified assessor. It provides a higher level of assurance for businesses handling sensitive data or operating in regulated environments. ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS: • Independent technical audit by a certified assessor • Vulnerability scans and simulated attack testing. • In-depth testing of workstations, servers, and mobile devices. BENEFITS Enhanced Assurance: Confirms security controls are correctly implemented and effective Increased Trust: Demonstrates strong cyber security to clients, partners, and regulators Reduced Risk: Identifies weaknesses before attackers can exploit them.
